messages:
sam (AE): quick sync — ACME infra wants to validate an on-prem private deployment in their air-gapped datacenter. they asked for: packaging options, upgrade cadence, offline license activation, and any enterprise blockers. can we list constraints and an approach?
maya (SE): tl;dr: we support container images + tarball install for air-gapped. need to confirm: allowed runtimes (containerd/runc), required kernel modules, and offline registry process.
raj (SRE): add OS matrix: ubuntu 20.04/22.04 and RHEL 8.6 are the only tested ones for this POC. kernel >=5.4. we should call out unsupported: old CentOS7 kernels.
zoe (sales-eng): pricing q from buyer: do we charge for Dedicated vs Private differently for POC? they expect >3 nodes and want a quote. sam (AE): POC is free for 30 days but if they want enterprise support + private package we need a short-term commitment. i'll draft a quote after SE sign-off.
maya (SE): security Qs: offline KMS/HSM integration — we support bringing your own HSM via PKCS#11 for server key material; for token signing we can use customer-provided keys. must confirm their HSM vendor.
raj (SRE): upgrade cadence: we propose quarterly minor releases and security patch windows every 8 weeks for private installs. for air-gapped, upgrades require: 1) offline image bundle, 2) db migration plan, 3) maintenance window. note: zero-downtime rolling upgrade only if they have >=3 replicas.
sam (AE): customer asked about the installer: do we provide an automated offline bundle + runbook? maya (SE): yes — we produce an 'airgap-bundle.tar.gz' that contains images, manifests, and a signed manifest file. install steps are ~5 commands:
```
scp airgap-bundle.tar.gz acme-node:/tmp
tar xzf airgap-bundle.tar.gz
./install.sh --offline --registry ./local-registry
```
maya (SE): install.sh will run a local registry import if container runtime is available. if they don't allow container runtime, we can provide a binary tarball but feature parity is not guaranteed.
raj (SRE): blockers to call out:
- requires outbound access for license activation unless we do offline license file exchange
- need minimum 64GB RAM per GPU host (if they want model serving)
- kernel modules for nv_peer_mem for optimized RDMA (optional)
- cert rotation process must be manual in air-gapped mode unless they provision an internal CA service
zoe (sales-eng): they also passed over an infosec questionnaire. principal ask: can we accept CSV of answers + attestations? maya (SE): we can fill questionnaire but for high-sensitivity items we need legal signoff (esp around data residency and telemetry).
sam (AE): timelines — customer wants POC next week. can we get an SE onsite or remote? maya (SE): I'll do remote runbook assist. raj (SRE): i can support the first install window at 09:00 PST next Wed.
maya (SE): follow-ups I need from ACME: OS/version list, container runtime choice, HSM vendor, outbound policy (yes/no), and a point of contact with sudo on a host.
sam (AE): action items:
- sam: confirm POC dates with ACME and send NDA (if not done)
- zoe: prepare preliminary quote for private deployment + optional 24/7 support
- maya: prepare airgap bundle + runbook + fill initial infosec Qs
- raj: produce upgrade/runbook notes and kernel/module checklist
(edited) deploy-bot: POC ticket created: #POC-4521 (assignee: maya).
zoe (sales-eng): adding note — pricing for private deployment during POC: waived platform fee, only charge for optional dedicated support engineers if they want 24/7. include that in the quote. :+1:
sam (AE): perfect. i'll message ACME now with required items. thanks all.
